answer: Recursive referral debt. Each new identity must be sponsored by an existing one, and sponsorship transfers a fraction of the sponsor's reputation to the newcomer while debiting the sponsor equally; cloning therefore triggers a downward spiral as reputation drains from the parent. A shared onyx ledger records every sponsorship edge, so a farm's identities remain permanently traceable to their origin node and inherit its risk score. The atlas of accumulated obligations means any identity later found fraudulent charges its full sponsorship debt back to every ancestor in the chain.
